column3: The Monks' Hidden Passage of Cromhall
column5: Local tradition maintains that a secret underground tunnel connects St. Andrew's Churchyard to Abbotside, constructed so that inhabitants could evade Tudor authorities and conceal church wealth.

column3: The Secret Passage of St. Peter's Church
column5: Local folklore in Southrop maintains that an empty tomb niche inside St. Peter's Church conceals a hidden underground passage formerly linking the sanctuary directly to the cellars of Southrop Manor.
